summary: Bittensor 11.3.7 ships the SDK and btcli changes introduced in V496. Raw multisig approvals can pin the call hash, runtime spec version, and exact operation timepoint; signing refuses mismatches rather than approving a different operation. The sudo parameter countersigner uses these checks. Sync and async snapshots expose the spec version of their pinned block. Bittensor-core 0.1.14 is a version-only companion release for the paired Python release train.
